Name: dimDate
Expression:
VAR MinDate = CALCULATE(MIN(InTrans_Low_Margin[Date]))
VAR MaxDate = CALCULATE(MAX(InTrans_Low_Margin[Date]))
RETURN
ADDCOLUMNS(
    ADDCOLUMNS(
        CALENDAR(MinDate, MaxDate),
        "Index", RANKX(CALENDARAUTO(), [Date], , ASC)
    ),
    "Year", YEAR([Date]),
    "Quarter No", QUARTER([Date]),
    "Quarter", "Q" & QUARTER([Date]),
    "Month No", MONTH([Date]),
    "Month", FORMAT([Date], "MMM"),
    "Day", DAY([Date]),
    "Slicer Date",
    IF(
        [Date] = TODAY(),
        "Today",
        IF(
            [Date] < TODAY(),
            [Date] & ""
        )
    )
)

Name: UniqueParts
Expression:
DISTINCT(
    UNION(
        SELECTCOLUMNS(InMaster_Combine_Vault, "PART_NO", InMaster_Combine_Vault[PART_NO]),
        SELECTCOLUMNS(InTrans_Low_Margin, "PART_NO", InTrans_Low_Margin[Part No]),
        SELECTCOLUMNS(Parts_Low_Margin_jdis_InMaster, "PART_NO", Parts_Low_Margin_jdis_InMaster[Part No])
    )
)
